parent: T4b (NOT A RESULT x3, 2026-08-27, all at gate (1); docs/campaigns/T-family/T4b_RESULTS.md, gate_t4b.json). T4c re-runs T4b changing only the three things the T4b run measured to be wrong; no band, threshold, reference, floor or control relaxed.
reference: ERCOFTAC Classic Collection case025, ij2lr family (H/D = 2, Re = 23000), docs/campaigns/T-family/reference-data/ercoftac_case025/ (HELD)
solver: buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam (ESI v2606), kOmegaSST, beta 0, axisymmetric wedge 2.5 deg, recycling (mapped) inlet, wall-resolved on every level

registered_changes_vs_T4b.A_mesh: jet-core/pipe radial division nrj = 3N/2 (T4b: 3N/4), family-wide; wall-jet radial, axial and pipe-axial unchanged; r = 2 preserved; cells 3.75 N^2 (T4b: 2.625 N^2). Fixes coarse C2 (resolution-limited) and lowers every residual plateau.
registered_changes_vs_T4b.B_relaxation: under-relaxation U/T/k/omega 0.7 -> 0.6, family-wide (p_rgh 0.3 unchanged); damps the medium velocity-residual limit cycle. Iteration-path only; the converged fixed point, and thus every graded value, is unchanged.
registered_changes_vs_T4b.C_endTime: 20000/30000/40000 -> 30000/60000/64000; writeInterval 2000/3000/4000 and purgeWrite 2 UNCHANGED so C6.3 measures the identical iteration window.

roache_floors.source: scripts/roache_triple.py, imported by name (MESH_STANDARD.md section 10.5, chief ruling 01967a7b); the comparator REFUSES if these two numbers differ from the import
roache_floors.ground: STAGNANT_FLOOR 0.5 = p_expected/3 with p_expected = 1.5 at r = 2 (T11 AMENDMENT 1 rule, the family floor): below it adjacent-level errors differ by < 2^0.5 = 1.41x, the levels-too-close-to-resolve-an-order state; P_MIN 0.05 is the degenerate floor (|p| < 0.05: e21 ~ e32, the fitted order is rounding residual). Both states are NOT A RESULT at gate (2); the floor can only move a row INTO NOT A RESULT.

graded_rows.band_rule: +-0.02 in U/U_bulk at every station (ERCOFTAC: mean velocity within +-2 percent of bulk), identical to T4/T4b; the reference value is RE-READ from the held file at every run, never from this block

C1.what: plate y+_max < 1.0 on every level, READ by the comparator through buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam -postProcess -func yPlus on a scratch copy

C1b.what: pipeWall y+_max < 1.0 on every level, same reader (the T4b grading is inverted so this condition CAN pass; T4b measured 0.398 / 0.202 / 0.102; Change A does not move the wall cell)

C2.what: nozzle-exit centreline velocity U_c/U_bulk = max |U|/U_bulk along a sampled line across the exit plane y = H (axis to pipe wall, 200 points, cellPoint), within +-3 percent of the 1/7-power-law value 1.2245; the planted control aims at the cell nearest the line's current maximum and judges visibility on the whole sampled profile (max-norm), the C2 scalar's own change reported beside it

C3.what: global mass conservation |sum over all patches of phi| / |phi_inlet| < 1e-3, READ from surfaceFieldValue sums of the written phi

C4.what: planted-zero control, both arms, on EVERY reader on the grading path: G-row profile reader (frozen analyse_t4.planted_zero_control, aimed plant 1.234e-03 m/s with a measured detection floor); y+ reader (U x4 in a scratch copy must return y+ x2.000000000 exactly, AND the generic postProcess -func yPlus must return 0 beside it -- the blind reader shown blind); exit-line reader (aimed plant, measured floor); flux reader (inlet phi x1.01 must return the analytically predicted imbalance to 1e-9)

C5.what: strict completion rule with the age guard (mark_done_t4c.py); fields T U p_rgh alphat nut k omega phi

C6.what: iterative convergence, three parts, all levels

c6_1_floor.quantity: every p_rgh initial residual (every non-orthogonal corrector) over the LAST 2000 iterations

c6_2_not_growing.quantity: mean p_rgh initial residual over the last 1000 iterations divided by the mean over the preceding 1000

c6_3_field_change.quantity: max over G1/G2/G3 of |peak U/U_bulk change| between the last two written checkpoints

convergence_evidence_from_T4b.note: measured from the T4b run logs (T4b_IJ_{c,m,f}/log.solve), read-only; the basis for the T4c schedule (T4c_PREREGISTRATION.md section 5)
convergence_evidence_from_T4b.coarse: p_rgh AND velocity residuals dead-flat from ~4000 iterations at a mesh-limited floor ~2.11e-06 (solver tolerance 1e-09, so not solver-limited); C6.3 = 1.19e-09 (settled). Fixed by Change A, not by time.
convergence_evidence_from_T4b.medium: velocity residual reaches ~7.3e-7 by ~15000 iterations then oscillates (tail mean 7.3e-7, std 2.0e-7, COV 0.28); C6.2 = 1.1366 (growing), C6.3 = 2.848e-04. A LIMIT CYCLE -- iterations alone cannot clear it. Fixed by Change A (lower plateau) + Change B (damp the cycle).
convergence_evidence_from_T4b.fine: velocity residual still decaying at the tail, 6.4e-6 at 16000 to 9.4e-8 at 40000; 2nd-half log-regression ro ~ 0.44 per 4000-it. C6.3 = 8.170e-04 -- a clean decaying transient, fixed by Change C (longer endTime).

P1_yplus_plate_max.arithmetic: first cell unchanged from T4b; T4b measured 0.6893 / 0.3490 / 0.1758, so the T4b intervals carry over. Change A does not move the wall cell.

P1b_yplus_pipe_max.arithmetic: T4b measured 0.3979 / 0.2017 / 0.1020; wall cell unchanged, radial refinement only helps.

P2_Uc_over_Ubulk.note: THIN margin on coarse, disclosed. Ground: the T4b medium level (72 jet-core-radial) passed at 1.1909; T4c coarse now carries 72 jet-core-radial cells. C2 lower edge = 1.2245*(1-0.03) = 1.187765. Contingency if it fails: nrj = 2N (cells 4.5 N^2).

P4_p_rgh_floor_c.note: A PREDICTION, disclosed. T4b coarse floor 2.12e-06 was mesh-limited (c/m ratio 16x is anomalous beside m/f 1.5x); Change A is predicted to drop it below 1e-06. If it does not, that is a measured finding for the next step.

P5_medium_C6_3.mechanism: Change B (under-relaxation 0.7 -> 0.6) breaks the T4b medium limit cycle so the residual decays; Change A lowers the plateau; Change C gives the damped decay room.
P5_medium_C6_3.note: THINNEST margin, disclosed. The pre-change extrapolation (mesh + endTime ALONE, no relaxation) is ~2.14e-04 -- still FAILING the 2e-04 floor -- which is why Change B is included. Recorded so the post-run comparison measures what the relaxation change bought. Contingency if it still fails: under-relaxation 0.6 -> 0.5.

P6_fine_C6_3.note: clean decaying transient (ro ~ 0.44 per 4000-it); 6 write-interval blocks beyond 40000 clear the 2e-04 floor even at a pessimistic ro = 0.75 (8.17e-04 x 0.75^6 = 1.45e-04).

P7_graded_values_fine.note: a DIFFERENT mesh family from T4b (3.75 N^2 vs 2.625 N^2): no cross-rung triple; the T4b fine values are context, not a level. Band positions unchanged.

predictions.P8_triples: all three triples CONVERGING (T4b P8 hit; the mesh family behaves).

P9_fine_limit_cycle_contingency.prediction: the fine level had NOT plateaued at 40000 in T4b (residual still decaying), so at its extended 64000 endTime it is predicted to settle. IF the fine velocity residual instead reaches a limit cycle at its 64000 floor (as the medium did), C6.3 will not clear and that is a MEASURED finding -- a disclosed contingency, NOT a terminal fail -- whose remedy is the same as the medium's (deeper under-relaxation), not a re-diagnosis.
P9_fine_limit_cycle_contingency.disposition: measured finding, sequence to a relaxation deepening

cost.basis: T4b MEASURED per-cell-iteration rates (T4b_RESULTS.md section 7): c 6.9940e-06, m 7.1346e-06, f 9.7543e-06 core-s/cell-iteration; applied to the T4c cell counts at the T4c iteration counts. This is the C-155 correction (use the most recent measured per-level rates for this solver/family), the same discipline T4b used against T4.
cost.ceiling_rule: 1.5 x POINT: the ~4% rate rise from the x1.43 cell increase (coupled-solver mesh-scaling penalty, rate ~ cells^0.12) plus box contention are absorbed here, per T4b section 7.
cost.cap_rule: about 2.0 x POINT; timeout_s = cap_core_min x 60 / ranks (ranks 1)
cost.operational_flag: the fine level is ~24 h wall at POINT (cap 48 h) at ranks 1 -- the longest single run this ladder has scheduled. Ranks stay 1 (F15 decomposition-confound ruling).
cost.cost_basis: derived from measured T4b rates; dollars at the owner-stated rate, reported-by-owner, not measured (COMPUTE_BUDGET_CHARTER section 5)
